name: Bucharest
tagline: Belle Époque boulevards and a colossal palace
summary: Bucharest mixes Belle Époque mansions, communist monuments and buzzing nightlife. Tour the Palace of the Parliament, one of the world's largest buildings, browse the Carturesti Carusel bookshop, explore the old town and Revolution Square, and day-trip to Transylvania's castles.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn are pleasant; summer is hot.
arrival: Henri Coandă Airport is 30 to 45 minutes away by train or bus.
cashTip: Cards work widely; carry some lei for markets and small shops.
baseArea: Old Town or near Piața Romană
